Team responsible for Triaging security reports
The responsibility of Triage is to determine whether Node.js must take any action to mitigate the issue, and if so, to ensure that the action is taken.
Mitigation may take many forms, for example, a Node.js security release that includes a fix, documentation, an informational CVE or blog post.

visible_text_exited: When security releases are published, there is a built-in delay before the corresponding CVEs are publicly disclosed. This delay occurs because:
After the security release, we request the vulnerability reporter to disclose the details on HackerOne.
If the reporter does not disclose within one day, we proceed with forced disclosure to publish the CVEs.
The disclosure then goes through HackerOne's approval process before the CVEs become publicly available.
As a result, CVEs may not be immediately available when security releases are published, but will typically be disclosed within a few days of the release.
